svg.text: Complete visual asset concept for the Glass theme
ONE MATERIAL LANGUAGE / FOUR PAGE RECIPES
Broad strata, bright edge above current facts
Fine bands guide the six-entry scan
Stone stays neutral; pale mineral light shapes the glass.
Low contrast material detail; art stays behind readable facts.
Six identities in the current presentation model · one faceted line family.
Controls keep their meaning at every effects level.
Bundled type families; confident facts and precise time.
Noto Sans · body and explanatory copy
Noto Sans Mono · time, source, numeric labels
One material: matte interior, polished mineral edge.
A seam glint crosses the background; reduced motion holds the first frame.
